description: This file implements the client-side logic for making requests to the OpenAI API within a React/TypeScript project. It defines the function `makeOpenAIResponsesRequest`, which constructs and sends a streaming request to the API, handles various event types during the response stream, manages MCP tools, code interpreter events, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: makeOpenAIResponsesRequest
methods.description: Makes a streaming API call to OpenAI's response endpoint, handling events such as MCP events, code interpreter events, text deltas, reasoning content, and completion/usage data. It updates the UI and manages internal state throughout the response stream.
